column1: # Agent visibility catalog. One row per agent the deployment narrows.
# agent  the agent's short name, as the agent provider catalog and wiring.tsv
#        name it. An agent without a row is shown every model.
# names  comma-separated names the agent is shown: a declared group id or a
#        declared Magpie provider id. A provider id exposes the models starred
#        for that provider; Magpie's pickedModels stars stay the app's state.
# The deployment narrows an agent and never ticks a star. It passes no
# --only-picked, because that freezes the current list and would hide a model
